extracted.intended_audience: Legislative counsel and relevant agency officials (CIA personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Agency memorandum summarizing and assessing H.R. 283, a proposed amendment to chapter 19, title 5 (Administrative Procedure Act) that would restrict post‑employment relationships between government agency personnel and interested private parties. The memo explains the bill's prohibition, its purpose (preventing collusion), and the Agency's view of any impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on employment between agency personnel and interested parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed amendment to the Administrative Procedure Act to 'prohibit the employment by any person of any member, official, attorney or employee of a government agency except under certain conditions.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The amendment seeks to prevent collusion between Federal employees participating in administrative tribunal proceedings and persons having an interest in those proceedings by limiting the conditions under which a subsequent employment relationship between these parties may exist. The memorandum assesses the proposal and concludes it 'appears to be of no direct concern to Agency personnel.'
